output.evaluation_note: The Vietnamese 'đại biểu' is an excellent match for the 'representative' or 'delegate' aspect of the English concept, which is explicitly included in the English sense context. While the English 'representation' can also refer to the abstract act of representing (which 'đại biểu' doesn't primarily cover) and Japanese '代表' can also mean 'archetype', the core pedagogical sense focusing on the person/group representing others is well-covered across all three languages. The slight semantic breadth difference is acceptable for a high-quality pedagogical resource.
